summary: NetClass Technology Inc, a Cayman Islands-incorporated, Singapore-based software firm listed on Nasdaq under NTCL, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering priced November 5, 2026. The deal covers 675,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.40 each and pre-funded warrants for up to 2,325,000 shares at $0.3875 (exercise price $0.0125), plus 3,000,000 30-day allocation rights for additional shares or pre-funded warrants at the same prices. Univest Securities acts as placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis; no board recommendation or overhang data is stated. This is an ordinary issuer equity shelf takedown, not a special situation.
